crossRefs.note: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.
Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud.
Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.
“You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

translations.web: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
translations.bsb: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
translations.kjv: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
translations.asv: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine adversaries: For false witnesses are risen up against me, And such as breathe out cruelty.
